_doc: Biome ramps, docs/07 s2.1 (ART-14). Each biome has a 3-stop ramp (low / mid / high) sampled by the per-pixel ramp value of 07 s3.1; tools/moonbake/ramp.py bakes this file into godot/assets/textures/moon_ramp.png (64 columns = ramp value, 16 rows = biome id; ids 8-15 reserved, magenta). Stops are sRGB albedo as authored in 07 s2.1; the moon_light include decodes them, so rendered colours follow 07 s1.5 (night = albedo x (0.30, 0.36, 0.55)). Ids are append-only. Change a stop here, then run `python -I tools/moonbake ramp` and update the ledger sha256.
